verdicts.claim_scope: STU-VID-011, 012a, 016, 016a, 017, 017a, 018, 019 in folio; rule 4b in package tests. Judged under the lead's ACCEPTED placement (record set beside the document, multicam precedent; SD-47). Independent row comparison by the validator (validator-r55-probe/probe_compare.py, written from the spec table and not derived from spt_gen.py, against the runtime Serialize output of shipped_sequence_presets() / shipped_editing_modes()): 391 of 391 shipped rows and 53 of 53 modes equal STU-VID-016a / 017a in every column, table order, 37 sizes, slot sums 188 / 52 / 60 / 59, every mode constraints_known false with no list; the only table row absent is DNX SQ 720p 29.97 (fps '--', line 23220, SD-44); the 5 'unknown' rows (48 fps, the code 113 rows) store frames plus the warning; defaulted_fields equal the declared readings on every row. Every shipped preset applied to a sequence yields a document validate_document accepts (probe f2). Round units cover what the builder did not run: see new_coverage (harness and harness-view feature units). deviations_from_brief.item: Brief items 1 and 4 say settings, immersive and preview go on the sequence record; STU-VID-018/019 say the same. They are NOT fields of StudioSequence. They live in StudioSequenceSettingsRecords, one entry per sequence_id, beside the document (the multicam and audio-routing precedent).
deviations_from_brief.why: StudioSequence is built with exhaustive struct literals in 7 other crates (git grep 'StudioSequence {': 110 matches in 52 files outside folio, some of them function signatures), all outside this lane's owned paths.
deviations_from_brief.consequence: MT-33701 and MT-33702 are partly met; an earlier-shape sequence has no settings and no editing mode.
deviations_from_brief.decision_needed: lead: accept the record set, or authorise a lane that owns those literal sites to move the record onto StudioSequence.

deviations_from_brief.item: crates/hsk-studio-folio/src/composition.rs is outside the brief's named paths: one word changed, validate_immersive made pub(crate), so immersive rules are reused rather than copied.
deviations_from_brief.decision_needed: lead: waiver for this one out-of-scope edit (GLOBAL-SCOPE-005).

deviations_from_brief.item: New module sequence_preset.rs with a sequence_preset/ directory of 3 files, where the brief names one new module. No single style-registry module exists: the registry is sections (StudioPaintStyle in paint.rs, audio_preset.rs, motion_preset.rs), so the preset section is in sequence_preset.rs and no registry file changed.

declared_readings: Studio-minted, not in the spec or Accord's canonical list (STU-CON-008 concern): schema id hsk.studio.sequence_settings@1 (precedent hsk.studio.multicam_records@1), command ids sequence.preset.save_from_sequence, sequence.preset.apply, sequence.editing_mode.set, preset ids and mode ids (slugs of the table names). Time-display wire tokens are also Studio's: Pulse has none, the codes are the spec's.
Time display: the same 15 members and codes as Pulse's TimeDisplay, by reading pulse/src/display.rs; no cross-crate test pins it, because folio may not depend on pulse.

Code 113 rows (5, all 48 fps): STU-VID-012b's fallback needs a frame-rate-matched timecode member and 48 fps has none, so frames plus warning time_display_code_113, as Pulse's TimeDisplay::matching. UNVERIFIED.

defaulted_fields on shipped presets: working colour space where the row has --, use_maximum_bit_depth, use_maximum_render_quality, allow_linear_compositing and initial_audio_track_count 4 are STU-VID-011 defaults. These are Studio readings with no declared default: auto_tone_map false outside BT.2100 rows, preview codec null with frame size equal to the sequence, immersive null. initial_audio_track_count 4 is also applied to the multichannel rows although the clause ties it to stereo.
The last HDR row is named 59.94 fps but declares 60 fps and 60 fps timecode; reproduced as declared.
apply: writes the frame rate onto the sequence even when it holds clips, and a sequence without an entry gains one with mode custom. Vendor parity UNVERIFIED (D5).

Bounds are Studio's: frame sides 4..=30000 (composition bounds), sample rate 1..=768000, 4096 presets, depth 8, 1024 modes, 1024 per allow-list; a mode with constraints_known false may not store list entries.
